notes.title: Free 2 Play coming soon
notes.content:
Dear players,

Race to Kyiv will soon hopefully enter full f2p. This comes with simply lack of time to work on the game. We appreciate the modest community which was interested enough to buy and keep the product for the lol factor.

Perhaps if this ever ends up viral, or otherwise people will want me to, I will continue working on it for giggles and fun of growing playerbase.

notes.title: Coming Features, Roadmap, and Character Models!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your service to the Grain Depot in Kyiv!
We have now sold over 200 copies and continue on our journey!

In the roadmap we have few features lined down:

-More enemies (and friendly units!)
-Main Character framework

-Additional Weapons
-Vehicle Upgrades
-Achievements
-Working Online Leaderboards
-Map Rework (so it doesnt look the way it does)

We're also working on the Anti Cheat due to incoming Online leaderboards.
Stay tuned everyone, and thank you! In the meantime, have a look at some of the characters!

In the meantime, familiarize yourself with our crew!
